note: Edda the guard. See hob.json for the format.

greeting: Keep your hands where I can see them.
complaint: I apologize, my head aches terribly.
Forgive me, I have not slept well.
I am unwell. Forgive my manner.
A sickness has taken me since dusk.
Not my best day, I am afraid.
The ache behind my eyes will not leave.
Pardon me. I can barely stand.

text: Safe enough by day. Wolves hunt at night.
The hills are quiet. The woods are not.
Build a lean-to near a fire. Warmth matters.
A lean-to keeps the rain off. Set one by the pond.
